system.description:
You are trained in Echani unarmed fighting techniques, giving you an advantage in hand-to-hand combat.

Prerequisites: Dexterity 13, Martial Arts I

Effect: You can double the damage bonus provided by your Strength modifier to Unarmed Attacks (minimum +1) provided you make only one Unarmed attack this turn.

Once per encounter when you deal damage to a target with an Unarmed Attack you may make an immediate Unarmed Attack against the target's Fortitude Defense as a Free Action; if successful, you knock your opponent to the ground (Prone) in their current square, provided they are no more than one size larger than you.

Additional Echani Training Effects

If you have the Echani Expertise Talent, whenever you score a Critical Hit with an Unarmed attack, the target is immediately knocked to the ground (Prone) in its current square, provided that the target is no more than one size larger than you
